correctness.rationale: The outer [6,3,4] MDS property gives 45 nonzero quaternary weight-4 words and 18 weight-6, hence binary 1+45z^8+18z^12. For a binary two-plane, 2|supp|=wt(a)+wt(b)+wt(a+b)>=24; minimum supports require three words of weight 8. Partition by overlap 4,3,2 of the two four-coordinate outer supports gives 15,180,45 plane profiles respectively, each a distinct 12-mask because any 3-space support has >=14. Incidence count 45*C(10,4)+18=9468 gives 8748 masks with one nonzero supported word and 9576 with none; 240 masks have 3 supported nonzero words and four completions. Independent full finite reconstruction corroborated all counts, not extrapolated to any other code.
residual_risks: Any included finite computations are corroboration only; the universal conclusions rest on the reconstructed proofs.
